import{useEffect}from'react';import{startUserTimeSpend,stopUserTimeSpend,installUserTimeSpendListeners}from'../services/userTimeSpendService';/*
  useUserTimeSpend — jis screen/module par user hai uska time
  POST /manage-usertimespend par bhejta hai (type: "erp").

  `screenName` badle to pehli screen close + nayi start.
  Unmount / tab close / logout par last screen flush.
*/export default function useUserTimeSpend(screenName){useEffect(()=>installUserTimeSpendListeners(),[]);useEffect(()=>{startUserTimeSpend(screenName);return()=>{stopUserTimeSpend();};},[screenName]);}
